QuestInfo.name: [Hayato] The New Base
QuestInfo.0: Yukimori says you aren't in Sokoku anymore. Is that even possible? You should visit the new base and talk to the others.
QuestInfo.1: Check out the new base, Momijigaoka. It should be at the top of the hill covered in maple trees.
QuestInfo.2: You arrived at Momijigaoka alone to speak with Yukimori.

0.0: We have christened our base Momijigaoka. It is hidden by a copse of scarlet maple trees. I will take you there.

no.0: Do you need more time to recover? I won't rush you.

1.0: This is Momijigaoka. Many great leaders preside within its walls. Ask around, and you will find the path to your destiny.

yes.0: I will take my leave. I'm glad I found another survivor in this strange land. I wish you well.
yes.1: Oh, if you have lost your weapon, take one of mine. I know they are not of noble standing, but they will serve you well.

default.0: Momijigaoka is at the top of that hill.
